registry: Red-on-Rust historical-audit disposition registry (repair pass v2, V-06)
derived_artifact_notice: The records are authored governance records (like reg/status-transitions.json); the rendered projection state/02-dispositions.md is generated by state/_project.py and must not be hand-edited.
purpose: Prevents a historical audit snapshot from being mistaken for current repository state. Every record binds a finding/finding-family to the governance action that resolved or carried it and to its current disposition. Historical audit content is immutable unless an explicitly authorized normative correction requires otherwise; protected snapshots are hash-pinned and state/_project.py fails the repository gate on any change to them.
rules: A disposition record is authority ABOUT history, not a second source of normative truth: current authority is always the named requirement/addendum/verdict, never this file's prose.
Resolving-action kinds: frozen-addendum | repository-gate-adoption | governance-repair | none-carried | none-register-staleness-intentionally-preserved.
Every resolved U-item in spec/09 must be covered by at least one RESOLVED record (checked mechanically).
Protected snapshots are sha256-pinned; editing a protected historical file is a provenance violation and fails check.py until the disposition record is deliberately updated by its owner.
No record may promote any evidence status: REF1-CONDITIONAL and V1-CONDITIONAL are carried at exactly their audited wording.
